models.name: shopping_mall_channels
models.description:
System channels for organizing content and features. Represents distinct sections or areas of the platform like primary shopping, seller marketplace, admin portal, etc. This is a reference table used by other components to route functionality. Must maintain active/inactive states for management.

@link shopping_mall_sections (1:N) - channels contain multiple sections
- 'active' status determines whether channel is visible to users
- 'code' is the internal identifier used in configuration

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Internal identifier code used in configuration files and system references. Must be unique and snake_case format. Examples: 'sales', 'sellerHub', 'adminDashboard'.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the channel displayed in admin interface. Examples: 'Sales Channel', 'Seller Hub', 'Admin Dashboard'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the channel's purpose and scope. Used for admin documentation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Active/inactive state of the channel. Only active channels are available for assignment to sections and features. Values: 'active', 'inactive'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this channel was created. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this channel was last updated. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used for audit purposes when channels are deactivated permanently. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_sections
models.description: Content sections within channels, providing organization for user interfaces and system navigation. Each section belongs to exactly one channel and can be organized hierarchically. Used by frontend routing and admin configuration.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_channel_id
foreignFields.description: Section's parent channel. {@link shopping_mall_channels.id}.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Internal identifier code used in configuration files and system references. Must be unique across all sections and follow snake_case format. Examples: 'productList', 'cartSummary', 'checkoutProcess'.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the section displayed in admin interface. Examples: 'Product List', 'Cart Summary', 'Checkout Process'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the section's purpose and scope. Used for admin documentation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Active/inactive state of the section. Only active sections are rendered to users. Values: 'active', 'inactive'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this section was created. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this section was last updated. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used for audit purposes when sections are deactivated permanently. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_configurations
models.description: Global platform configuration settings that control behavior across the system. These are key-value pairs that determine feature flags, business rules, and operational parameters. No semantic structure assumed - maintains flexibility for future configurations.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Unique business key identifying this configuration setting. Follows snake_case format with domain-specific prefixes. Examples: 'platform_transaction_fee', 'payment_gateway_default', 'max_items_in_cart'.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name for this configuration, shown in admin UI. Examples: 'Platform Transaction Fee Percentage', 'Default Payment Gateway', 'Maximum Items Allowed in Cart'.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: Configuration value as a string. Can represent JSON, boolean, number, or text strings depending on context. Examples: '0.05', 'true', '{"enabled": true}', 'stripe'.

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Data type of the configuration value. Used by admin interface for proper rendering and parsing. Values: 'string', 'number', 'boolean', 'json'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the configuration's purpose, usage, and acceptable values. Used for admin documentation.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was created. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this configuration was last updated. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used for audit purposes when configurations are deactivated permanently. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_payment_gateways
models.description: Supported payment gateway configurations for processing transactions. Defines which payment methods are available to customers and how they integrate with the system. Used by checkout process to determine available payment options.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Internal identifier code used in configuration. Follows snake_case format. Examples: 'stripe', 'paypal', 'bank_transfer'.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the payment gateway displayed to users. Examples: 'Credit/Debit Card', 'PayPal', 'Bank Transfer'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the payment gateway's functionality and usage notes for administrators and customers.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Enabled/disabled state of the payment gateway. Only 'active' gateways are shown to customers during checkout. Values: 'active', 'inactive'.

plainFields.name: priority
plainFields.description: Display priority for payment methods in the UI. Higher values appear first in the list. Range: 1-100.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment gateway was configured. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment gateway was last updated. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used for audit purposes when payment gateways are deactivated permanently. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_dispute_types
models.description: Categorized dispute types for customer-seller conflicts, used to standardize resolution processes. Each dispute type defines the category and typical handling procedures. This is reference data used by the dispute resolution system.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: System identifier code for the dispute type. Follows snake_case format. Examples: 'product_damaged', 'wrong_item_received', 'not_delivered'.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the dispute category displayed in admin interface and customer forms. Examples: 'Product Damaged', 'Wrong Item Received', 'Item Not Delivered'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of the dispute type, criteria for categorization, and typical resolution steps. Used for admin training and customer guidance.

plainFields.name: refund_eligible
plainFields.description: Whether this dispute type typically qualifies for refund processing. True for cases where customer is entitled to full or partial refund.

plainFields.name: return_required
plainFields.description: Whether this dispute type typically requires the customer to return the product. True for physical goods that must be returned for resolution.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this dispute type was added to the system. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this dispute type was last updated. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used for audit purposes when dispute types are deactivated permanently. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_shipping_carriers
models.description: Supported shipping carriers for order fulfillment. Defines courier partners that the platform integrates with for shipment tracking and logistics management. Used by sellers to select shipping options and by system to parse tracking data.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Internal identifier code used in configuration and API integrations. Follows snake_case format. Examples: 'fedex', 'ups', 'dhl', 'usps', 'local_courier'.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the shipping carrier displayed to sellers and customers. Examples: 'FedEx', 'UPS', 'DHL', 'USPS', 'Local Courier'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the carrier's service coverage, delivery times, and integration requirements.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Active/inactive state of the carrier integration. Only 'active' carriers are available for selection during shipping. Values: 'active', 'inactive'.

plainFields.name: tracking_url_format
plainFields.description: URL template for generating tracking links using tracking numbers. Use {tracking_number} as placeholder. Examples: 'https://www.fedex.com/tracking?trackingnumber={tracking_number}'

plainFields.name: tracking_number_pattern
plainFields.description: Regular expression pattern for validating tracking numbers format for this carrier. Examples: '^[0-9]{12}$' for FedEx, '1Z[0-9A-Z]{16}$' for UPS.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this carrier was added to the system. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this carrier was last updated. Standard temporal field for audit trails.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. Used for audit purposes when carriers are deactivated permanently. Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_customers
models.description: Primary customer entity representing registered buyers on the shoppingMall platform. Each customer has unique authentication credentials and identity. This is a primary entity because customers directly manage their accounts (registration, login, profile updates) and require independent API endpoints for user management operations. Customer account status can be active, suspended, banned, or pending email verification. Note: This is not a person, but a connection basis for purchasing activities.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Customer's unique email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all customers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password using secure algorithm for authentication. Never stored as plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status of the customer. Valid values: "active", "suspended", "banned", "pending_email_verification", "rejected". Controls access to platform features.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was created. Tracks account lifecycle onset.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was last updated. Tracks active account modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer account was soft-deleted. NULL if account is still active. Enables account recovery and audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_customer_sessions
models.description: Supporting entity for customer authentication sessions. Each record represents an active or expired login session for a customer. This is a subsidiary entity because sessions are managed entirely through customer account operations (login creates session, logout invalidates session) and do not require independent user-facing API endpoints. Mirroring the required session table pattern: id, customer_id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at with composite index.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the customer account that owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led the customer to the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created and authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expired or was explicitly invalidated. NULL if session is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sellers
models.description: Primary seller entity representing registered merchants who list and sell products on the shoppingMall platform. Each seller has unique authentication credentials and identity. This is a primary entity because sellers directly manage their merchant accounts (registration, login, profile updates) and require independent API endpoints for dealer management operations. Seller account status can be active, suspended, banned, pending_review, or rejected. Note: This is not a person, but a business entity for selling activities.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Seller's unique email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all sellers.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password using secure algorithm for authentication. Never stored as plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status of the seller. Valid values: "active", "suspended", "banned", "pending_review", "rejected". Controls access to merchant features.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was created. Tracks account lifecycle onset.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was last updated. Tracks active account modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the seller account was soft-deleted. NULL if account is still active. Enables account recovery and audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_seller_sessions
models.description: Supporting entity for seller authentication sessions. Each record represents an active or expired login session for a seller. This is a subsidiary entity because sessions are managed entirely through seller account operations (login creates session, logout invalidates session) and do not require independent user-facing API endpoints. Mirroring the required session table pattern: id, seller_id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at with composite index.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the seller account that owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led the seller to the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created and authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expired or was explicitly invalidated. NULL if session is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_admins
models.description: Primary admin entity representing platform administrators with full system access and control. Each admin has unique authentication credentials and identity. This is a primary entity because admins directly manage their system accounts (login, logout, password reset) and require independent API endpoints for administrative operations. Admin account status can be active, suspended, or banned (rejected/pending not applicable). Note: This is a system operator role with elevated privileges.

plainFields.name: email
plainFields.description: Admin's unique email address used for authentication and communication. Must be unique across all admins.

plainFields.name: password_hash
plainFields.description: Hashed password using secure algorithm for authentication. Never stored as plain text. Required for login functionality.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Account status of the admin. Valid values: "active", "suspended", "banned". Controls access to system administration features.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was created. Tracks account lifecycle onset.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was last updated. Tracks active account modifications.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the admin account was soft-deleted. NULL if account is still active. Enables account recovery and audit trails.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_sessions
models.description: Supporting entity for admin authentication sessions. Each record represents an active or expired login session for an admin. This is a subsidiary entity because sessions are managed entirely through admin account operations (login creates session, logout invalidates session) and do not require independent user-facing API endpoints. Mirroring the required session table pattern: id, admin_id, ip, href, referrer, created_at, expired_at with composite index.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the admin account that owns this session. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}

plainFields.name: ip
plainFields.description: Client IP address from which the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: href
plainFields.description: URL of the page where the session was initiated.

plainFields.name: referrer
plainFields.description: Referrer URL that led the admin to the platform.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session was created and authenticated.

plainFields.name: expired_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this session expired or was explicitly invalidated. NULL if session is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_products
models.description: Main product entity representing items listed by sellers in the shopping mall. Each product can have multiple variants (SKUs) managed in a separate component. This table stores core product metadata. @link shopping_mall_sellers.id represents the seller who created and owns this product.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who owns this product. @link shopping_mall_sellers.id.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: The title of the product shown to customers. Must be descriptive.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the product including features and benefits.

plainFields.name: brand
plainFields.description: Brand name associated with this product. Can be the seller's brand or third-party.

plainFields.name: warranty_period
plainFields.description: Duration of product warranty expressed in natural language (e.g., '1 year', 'Limited lifetime').

plainFields.name: weight
plainFields.description: Weight of the product in kilograms (kg). Used for shipping cost calculation.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the product. Possible values: 'draft', 'active', 'frozen'. Draft: not visible to customers. Active: visible and purchasable. Frozen: hidden and non-purchasable, but retains history.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the product was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_categories
models.description: Hierarchical categories for organizing products. Categories can have parent-child relationships to form a tree structure. Customers browse and filter products by category. Admins manage the category tree.

foreignFields.name: parent_category_id
foreignFields.description: Parent category this category belongs to, if any. Self-referential relationship. @link shopping_mall_product_categories.id.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the category displayed to users in UI (e.g., 'Electronics').

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the category's purpose and included products.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the category was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attributes
models.description: Definition of reusable product attributes such as color, size, material, etc. Attributes are created once and can be applied to multiple products to define variation options. Defined by admins or sellers with product creation privileges.

plainFields.name: name
plainFields.description: Internal name of the attribute (e.g., 'color'). Used in code and APIs. Must be unique.

plainFields.name: display_label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label of the attribute shown to users (e.g., 'Color').

plainFields.name: data_type
plainFields.description: Data type of the attribute values. Possible values: 'text', 'select', 'range'. Text: freeform string. Select: predefined choices. Range: numeric range with min/max.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attribute was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attribute was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the attribute was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_values
models.description: The actual values for a product attribute. Each value is linked to a specific attribute (e.g., 'red' for 'color' attribute). These are managed through the parent attribute and are subsidiary to it. Used to define possible selections for SKUs.

foreignFields.name: product_attribute_id
foreignFields.description: The attribute this value belongs to. @link shopping_mall_product_attributes.id.

plainFields.name: value
plainFields.description: The actual value (e.g., 'Red', 'Large', 'Cotton') that users can select. Must be unique per attribute.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this attribute value was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_product_images
models.description: Images associated with products. A product can have multiple images (e.g., multiple angles, details). One image can be marked as primary. Images are managed as subsidiary to products.

foreignFields.name: product_id
foreignFields.description: The product this image belongs to. @link shopping_mall_products.id.

plainFields.name: image_url
plainFields.description: URL to the hosted image file. Must be a valid HTTP/HTTPS URI.

plainFields.name: is_primary
plainFields.description: True if this is the primary image used as the product's thumbnail. Only one image per product can be primary.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was uploaded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image metadata was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the image was logically deleted (soft delete). Null if not deleted.

models.name: shopping_mall_skus
models.description: Core SKU (Stock Keeping Unit) entity representing a unique variant of a product defined by attribute combinations. Each SKU has independent inventory and pricing. This table establishes the primary link between products and their variants. Related to shopping_mall_products.id via foreign key. Must never be modified directly by users - only through product management with attribute selection.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: The parent product this SKU belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU was created in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete indicator. When set, this SKU is considered archived and no longer active in the catalog. Null means active.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_attributes
models.description: Junction table that establishes the many-to-many relationship between SKUs (shopping_mall_skus) and product attribute values (shopping_mall_product_attribute_values). Each row represents one attribute value assigned to a specific SKU. For example, 'color=blue' or 'size=large'. Dynamically populated when a product with attributes is created. Avoids denormalization of attribute values into the SKUs table.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: The SKU to which this attribute value is assigned. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_attribute_value_id
foreignFields.description: The specific attribute value (e.g., 'red', 'xl') assigned to this SKU. {@link shopping_mall_product_attribute_values.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this SKU-attribute relationship was created.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_prices
models.description: Stores override pricing for individual SKUs when the price differs from the base product price. Default price inheritance is handled application-side: if price_value is null, use product's base price. Allows sellers to set different prices for different variants (e.g., size XL costs more than size S). Only the active price for each SKU is stored - no history kept here as price history is captured in order items. Never calculate this value; store exact override amounts.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: The SKU for which this price is set. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: price_value
plainFields.description: The override price for this SKU. Null means inherit parent product price. Non-negative value.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this price was created or last updated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this price was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_sku_inventory
models.description: Records the current inventory level for each SKU. This is the authoritative source for stock quantity. Inventory automatically decreases when an order is confirmed. May be manually increased by sellers during restock. Zero inventory means the SKU is out-of-stock and hidden from customers. No negative inventory allowed. This table is updated atomically with order confirmation and direct seller adjustments.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: The SKU for which inventory is tracked. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Current quantity in stock. Must be zero or positive integer. Zero means the SKU is out of stock. Never negative.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory level was last updated (e.g., by order or seller restock).

models.name: shopping_mall_carts
models.description: Active shopping carts owned by authenticated customers. Each cart represents a session of product selections that the user intends to purchase. Items are added and removed by the customer until checkout. This is a primary entity because customers independently manage their carts, view contents, and initiate checkout from this context. {@link shopping_mall_cart_items} records belong to this cart.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this cart. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the cart was created. Always populated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the cart was last modified (item added/removed). Always populated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, cart is active. Used for user-initiated cart deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_cart_items
models.description: Individual product items within a customer's active shopping cart. Each item references a specific SKU and locks in the price at the time it was added to the cart. This is a subsidiary entity because it only exists within the context of a cart and is managed entirely through the parent cart (do not create/modify directly). Cart items may be moved to wishlist or removed. {@link shopping_mall_carts} contains these items. {@link shopping_mall_skus} represents the product variation stored.

foreignFields.name: cart_id
foreignFields.description: Cart that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_carts.id}.

foreignFields.name: sku_id
foreignFields.description: The specific SKU (product variant) being added to cart. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units of this SKU in the cart. Must be at least 1.

plainFields.name: price_at_addition
plainFields.description: Price of the SKU at the time it was added to the cart. Maintains price lock even if product price changes later. This ensures customer trust and consistency during checkout.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this item was added to the cart. Always populated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this item's quantity was last modified or it was moved from wishlist. Always populated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, item is active in cart. Used for item removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlists
models.description: Active wishlists owned by authenticated customers. Each wishlist represents items the customer has saved for future consideration. Unlike carts, wishlists don't imply immediate purchase intent. This is a primary entity because customers independently manage their wishlists (add/remove items, view contents). {@link shopping_mall_wishlist_items} records belong to this wishlist.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who owns this wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the wishlist was created. Always populated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the wishlist was last modified (item added/removed). Always populated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, wishlist is active. Used for user-initiated wishlist deletion.

models.name: shopping_mall_wishlist_items
models.description: Individual product items within a customer's wishlist. Each item references a specific SKU and locks in the price at the time it was added to the wishlist. This is a subsidiary entity because it only exists within the context of a wishlist and is managed entirely through the parent wishlist (do not create/modify directly). Items may be moved to cart or removed. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists} contains these items. {@link shopping_mall_skus} represents the product variation stored.

foreignFields.name: wishlist_id
foreignFields.description: Wishlist that contains this item. {@link shopping_mall_wishlists.id}.

foreignFields.name: sku_id
foreignFields.description: The specific SKU (product variant) being saved to wishlist. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: price_at_addition
plainFields.description: Price of the SKU at the time it was added to the wishlist. Maintains price lock even if product price changes later. Used for price-drop notifications to customers.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When this item was added to the wishlist. Always populated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When this item was last modified (moved from cart or updated metadata). Always populated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, item is active in wishlist. Used for item removal.

models.name: shopping_mall_guest_carts
models.description: Shopping carts for anonymous (guest) users who are not logged in. These carts are tied to a browser session (guest_session_id) rather than a user account. Used to allow guest users to add items to cart before login. This is a primary entity because guests independently manage these carts and may merge them when logging in. {@link shopping_mall_cart_items} records belong to this guest cart. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions} stores session data.

foreignFields.name: guest_session_id
foreignFields.description: The customer session tied to this guest cart. {@link shopping_mall_customer_sessions.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: When the guest cart was created. Always populated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: When the guest cart was last modified (item added/removed). Always populated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete timestamp. If null, cart is active. Used for session expiration (after 30 days).

models.name: shopping_mall_orders
models.description: Immutable snapshot of a completed transaction at checkout time. Captures the state of cart, shipping, payment, and totals exactly when the order was placed. This table represents a persistent audit record of customer purchases. Cannot be modified after creation. References cart items from shopping_mall_cart_items at the time of purchase. Used by order tracking, refund systems, and audit logs.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_cart_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the cart item state at time of purchase. {@link shopping_mall_cart_items.id}. This is a snapshot reference, not a live link to the current cart state.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who placed the order. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Snapshotted at order time for audit purposes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_status_id
foreignFields.description: Current status of this order. {@link shopping_mall_order_statuses.id}. References the approved status code.

plainFields.name: order_number
plainFields.description: Unique, human-readable order identifier in format "ORD-YYYYMMDD-NNNN". Used for customer communications and support.

plainFields.name: subtotal
plainFields.description: Sum of all line item prices at time of order, before tax and shipping. Locked at time of purchase and never changes.

plainFields.name: tax_amount
plainFields.description: Sales tax amount calculated at time of checkout based on shipping address. Fixed at order creation.

plainFields.name: shipping_amount
plainFields.description: Shipping cost calculated at time of checkout based on address and weight. Fixed at order creation.

plainFields.name: total_amount
plainFields.description: Final amount charged to customer (subtotal + tax + shipping). Locked at time of purchase.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: Currency code used for this transaction (e.g., "USD", "EUR"). Should match the payment method currency.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the order was placed and transaction was confirmed. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of the last status update. Updated whenever status changes via shopping_mall_order_status_history.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Allows for data retention for audit compliance while hiding from normal queries. Never physically delete orders.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_items
models.description: Represents individual line items in an order. Each row captures a product SKU, quantity, and price at the exact moment of purchase. This is not a reference to live inventory or cart items but a snapshot of the transaction. All data is immutable after creation. Used for order fulfillment, refund calculations, and revenue reporting.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Parent order that this line item belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}. Required to link to the transaction snapshot.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_sku_id
foreignFields.description: The product SKU that was purchased at time of order. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}. Captured as a snapshot rather than a live reference.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: Number of units purchased in this line item. Locked at time of checkout.

plainFields.name: unit_price
plainFields.description: Price per unit at time of purchase. This is a snapshot of the SKU price at checkout, which may differ from current market price.

plainFields.name: total_price
plainFields.description: Total for this line item (quantity × unit_price). Calculated and locked at order creation.

plainFields.name: sku_attributes
plainFields.description: JSON representation of the SKU's specific attributes at purchase time (e.g., color, size, material). Used for accurate fulfillment when SKU details later change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order line item was added to the order. Immutable.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this order item was last modified (rare, typically only during refund adjustments).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Allows for data retention for audit compliance while hiding from normal queries. Never physically delete order items.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_shipping_addresses
models.description: Snapshot of the shipping address as it existed at the time of order placement. Contains all address details in plain text fields to ensure consistency and auditability. Never references live customer addresses - all data is copied from the customer's profile at checkout time and preserved forever. Required for accurate fulfillment, dispute resolution, and tax calculations.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this shipping address belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}. Required for linking address to transaction.

plainFields.name: recipient_name
plainFields.description: Full name of the recipient as provided during checkout.

plainFields.name: address_line1
plainFields.description: First line of the street address.

plainFields.name: address_line2
plainFields.description: Second line of the street address (apt, suite, etc.). Optional.

plainFields.name: city
plainFields.description: City name as provided during checkout.

plainFields.name: state_province
plainFields.description: State, province, or region name as provided during checkout.

plainFields.name: postal_code
plainFields.description: Postal or ZIP code as provided during checkout.

plainFields.name: country
plainFields.description: Country name as provided during checkout (ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 format).

plainFields.name: phone
plainFields.description: Phone number for delivery contact purposes.

plainFields.name: address_type
plainFields.description: Label indicating address type ("home", "work", "other", or custom).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this address snapshot was captured at checkout.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (typically only during correcting delivery attempts).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Allows for data retention for audit compliance while hiding from normal queries. Never physically delete address snapshots.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_payment_methods
models.description: Snapshot of the payment method as it existed at the time of order placement. This table stores obfuscated payment data (last 4 digits, type, provider) rather than live references to customer payment profiles. Used for transaction recording, dispute resolution, and refund processing. Ensure PCI compliance by never storing sensitive payment details.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this payment method was used for. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}. Required for linking to transaction.

plainFields.name: payment_gateway
plainFields.description: Name of the payment processor used (e.g., "Stripe", "PayPal", "Adyen"). Must match shopping_mall_payment_gateways table entries.

plainFields.name: payment_type
plainFields.description: Type of payment method ("credit_card", "debit_card", "digital_wallet", "bank_transfer").

plainFields.name: last_four
plainFields.description: Last four digits of the payment card or identifier. Used for customer reference and reconciliation.

plainFields.name: exp_month
plainFields.description: Expiration month of the card (1-12). For digital wallets or bank transfers, this may be null.

plainFields.name: exp_year
plainFields.description: Expiration year of the card (YYYY). For digital wallets or bank transfers, this may be null.

plainFields.name: card_brand
plainFields.description: Card brand name ("Visa", "MasterCard", "American Express", etc.). For digital wallets or bank transfers, this may be null.

plainFields.name: account_number
plainFields.description: Obfuscated account number for bank transfers or digital wallets. Always masked, never complete.

plainFields.name: payment_provider_reference
plainFields.description: Unique reference ID returned by the payment provider for this transaction. Used for reconciliation and dispute resolution.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment method snapshot was captured at checkout.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (typically only during payment reversal or processing errors).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Allows for data retention for audit compliance while hiding from normal queries. Never physically delete payment snapshots.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_statuses
models.description: Reference table defining the valid status codes for order lifecycle management. Acts as a lookup for the order_status_id in shopping_mall_orders. This table provides consistent, standardized status codes and human-readable descriptions for all orders across the system. Used by UI for display, backend for state transitions, and reporting for aggregation.

plainFields.name: status_code
plainFields.description: Unique machine-readable status identifier (e.g., "pending", "processing", "shipped", "delivered", "cancelled", "returned"). Must match status transitions defined in order processing business logic.

plainFields.name: display_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name for display to customers and admins (e.g., "Order Placed", "Processing Payment", "Shipped").

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of what this status means in business terms and system behavior.

plainFields.name: is_terminal
plainFields.description: True if this status is final and no further transitions are allowed (e.g., delivered, cancelled, returned). False if transitioning is still possible.

plainFields.name: is_refundable
plainFields.description: True if customers can request refunds while in this status. False if refunds are prohibited (e.g., delivered status may allow refunds but cancelled does not).

plainFields.name: order_priority
plainFields.description: Numerical ranking for ordering statuses chronologically (e.g., pending=1, processing=2, shipped=3, delivered=4). Used in status history timelines.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status definition was created or last updated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification to this status definition.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Allow deactivation of statuses without breaking historical order data.

models.name: shopping_mall_order_status_history
models.description: Append-only audit trail of all status transitions for each order. Records every change in order status with timestamp and admin/user responsible. This table ensures complete traceability and auditability for compliance, dispute resolution, and forensic analysis. Never modify or delete entries - only insert new records when status changes. Required by business rules for payment, shipment, and refund processes.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: The order this status change applies to. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}. Required to link status change to transaction.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_status_id
foreignFields.description: The new order status after transition. {@link shopping_mall_order_statuses.id}. Links to the status definition.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_admin_id
foreignFields.description: The admin who triggered this status change (if applicable). {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}. Optional for automated transitions.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who triggered this status change (e.g., marking as shipped). {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}. Used for tracking responsibility.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who triggered this status change (e.g., requesting cancellation). {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}. Used for accountability.

plainFields.name: previous_status_code
plainFields.description: The order status code before this transition (for comparison and audit trail). Stored as string for audit purposes even if reference data changes later.

plainFields.name: new_status_code
plainFields.description: The order status code after this transition (for audit trail). Stored as string for audit purposes even if reference data changes later.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Explanation for why this status change occurred. For admin actions: "Overrode decision due to customer complaint". For seller: "Package shipped with tracking #12345". For customer: "Requested cancellation after event cancellation".

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: Tracking number provided when order is marked as shipped. Optional field only populated during 'shipped' status transitions.

plainFields.name: carrier_name
plainFields.description: Shipping carrier name when tracking number is provided. Must match shopping_mall_shipping_carriers entries or be free text.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status change occurred. Immutable record of transition time.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp of last modification (should never be updated after creation).

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Soft delete marker. Never physically deleted - audit trails must be preserved for legal compliance.

models.name: shopping_mall_reviews
models.description: Core review entity representing customer feedback on products. A review is only allowed after order delivery. Verified purchase status is determined by existence of a related order. Includes review content and basic metadata. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id} for verified purchase verification. {@link shopping_mall_products.id} for product reference. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} for reviewer.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order that was completed and enabled this review. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}. Required for verified purchase assessment.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product that the review is about. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who wrote the review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Short title of the review (max 100 characters).

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Main review text content (max 2000 characters). Must be at least 10 characters.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the review was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_ratings
models.description: Numeric rating scores (1-5 stars) associated with reviews. Each review has exactly one rating. This entity is managed through its parent review and does not require independent API endpoints. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id} for review reference.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review this rating belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

plainFields.name: score
plainFields.description: Rating score from 1 to 5. Must be an integer between 1 and 5 inclusive.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the rating was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the rating was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_responses
models.description: Seller responses to customer reviews. Each review can have one response per seller. Seller responses are editable for only 7 days after posting. This is a supporting entity managed exclusively through its parent review. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id} for parent review. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} for seller author.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review that this response answers. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_seller_id
foreignFields.description: The seller who wrote this response. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

plainFields.name: body
plainFields.description: Response content from seller (max 1000 characters).

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the response was posted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the response was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the response was soft-deleted. Null if active.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_reports
models.description: Reports filed by customers to flag inappropriate or problematic reviews. Each report is associated with one specific review and one reporter. Used for moderation workflow. This is a system-maintained entity supporting moderation and does not have independent user management. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id} for reported review. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} for reporter.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review that has been reported. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who filed this report. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the report was filed.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Report status: 'pending', 'flagged', 'approved', 'rejected'.

plainFields.name: admin_notes
plainFields.description: Internal notes from admin for report handling. Optional.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_report_reasons
models.description: Reason codes for review reports. Each report can have multiple reasons. Standardized list of report reasons enables consistent moderation. This is a supporting entity that exists only as children of review reports. {@link shopping_mall_review_reports.id} for parent report.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_report_id
foreignFields.description: The report this reason belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_review_reports.id}.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Predefined reason for report: 'spam', 'inappropriate_content', 'false_information', 'other'.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the reported issue (if reason is 'other'). Optional.

models.name: shopping_mall_review_votes
models.description: Helpful/not-helpful votes from customers on reviews. Each customer can vote once per review. This is a supporting entity used for ranking review quality and does not represent an independently managed entity. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id} for reviewed content. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} for voter.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_review_id
foreignFields.description: The review that received this vote. {@link shopping_mall_reviews.id}.

foreignFields.name: shopping_mall_customer_id
foreignFields.description: The customer who cast this vote. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: is_helpful
plainFields.description: True if vote is 'Helpful', false if 'Not Helpful'.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the vote was cast.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the vote was updated (if changed).

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory
models.description:
Current inventory levels for each SKU. Represents the authoritative source of stock quantity for each product variant. Updated atomically when orders are confirmed or inventory is adjusted. This is the primary entity for inventory management, and sellers and admins need to independently view and modify these values.

This table should be referenced by shopping_mall_inventory_alerts, shopping_mall_inventory_audits, and shopping_mall_inventory_deltas to establish the inventory context for alerts, audits, and deltas.

foreignFields.name: sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU whose inventory this record represents. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: quantity
plainFields.description: The current quantity of the product in stock. Must be zero or a positive integer. Negative inventory is not permitted. This value is updated atomically when orders are confirmed or inventory is manually adjusted.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this inventory record was last updated. Reflects the most recent change to the stock quantity. Always updated when the quantity changes.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_alerts
models.description:
Tracks inventory alerts for low-stock conditions. Whenever an inventory quantity falls to 3 units or fewer, an alert record is created. This table helps identify products that need replenishment. Alerts are automatically created and resolved based on inventory changes.

This table is subsidiary to shopping_mall_inventory as it provides alert state information that is managed automatically by the system based on inventory levels. It doesn't need independent API endpoints, only system-managed updates.

foreignFields.name: sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU that triggered this low-stock alert. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

plainFields.name: alert_threshold
plainFields.description: The fixed threshold at which the alert was triggered. Always 3 according to business requirements, representing when inventory falls to 3 units or fewer.

plainFields.name: alert_sent_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the low-stock alert was first triggered and notification was sent.

plainFields.name: resolved_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the alert was resolved (when inventory increased above 3 units). Null means the alert is still active.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_audits
models.description:
Complete audit trail of all inventory changes. Every time inventory is modified (through order confirmation, manual adjustment, or system process), a record is created here with the old and new values. This table captures the complete history for compliance and reconciliation.

This table is subsidiary to shopping_mall_inventory as it serves as an audit trail for inventory changes. It's append-only and managed automatically by system processes in response to inventory updates, not directly by users.

foreignFields.name: sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU whose inventory was changed. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: performed_by_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the actor who performed the inventory change. Either a seller or admin who made a manual adjustment, or system-generated when triggered by an order. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id} or {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}. This relationship references either seller or admin based on context.

plainFields.name: old_quantity
plainFields.description: The inventory quantity before the change occurred. Used to determine the delta.

plainFields.name: new_quantity
plainFields.description: The inventory quantity after the change occurred. Always the current value stored in shopping_mall_inventory.

plainFields.name: change_reason
plainFields.description: The business reason for the inventory change. Examples: 'Order confirmed', 'Manual adjustment', 'Inventory correction'.

plainFields.name: performed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the inventory change was applied. Always matches the updated_at of the corresponding shopping_mall_inventory record.

models.name: shopping_mall_inventory_deltas
models.description:
Tracks individual quantity changes (deltas) for inventory level adjustments. Each record represents a single change to an inventory quantity, recording the amount of change and its type. This complements shopping_mall_inventory_audits by providing a granular view of inventory changes, especially useful for reconciliation between inventory levels and order history.

This table is subsidiary to shopping_mall_inventory as it provides detailed change information that is automatically created by system processes and referenced for analytics and reconciliation.

foreignFields.name: sku_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the SKU whose inventory changed. {@link shopping_mall_skus.id}.

foreignFields.name: related_order_item_id
foreignFields.description: Reference to the order item that caused this change, if applicable. For example, when inventory is reduced by order confirmation. {@link shopping_mall_order_items.id}.

plainFields.name: delta_quantity
plainFields.description: The change in inventory quantity. Positive for restocks, negative for sales or removals. Used to calculate total change without needing to query original values.

plainFields.name: delta_type
plainFields.description: Classification of the type of delta. Values: 'sale' (reduction due to order), 'restock' (addition due to new inventory), 'adjustment' (manual correction).

plainFields.name: applied_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this delta was applied to inventory. Always matches the performed_at in shopping_mall_inventory_audits for the same change.

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_requests
models.description: Main entity for refund requests representing the unified abstraction for both customer-initiated and admin-initiated refund requests. This table serves as the primary business entity for refunds, with ownership details resolved through relationships to subtype entities (shopping_mall_refund_request_of_customers and shopping_mall_refund_request_of_admins). Contains all refund request metadata independent of originator type.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: The order for which this refund is requested. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: status_id
foreignFields.description: The current status of this refund request. {@link shopping_mall_refund_statuses.id}.

foreignFields.name: reason_id
foreignFields.description: The reason provided for the refund request. {@link shopping_mall_refund_reasons.id}.

plainFields.name: request_type
plainFields.description: Type of refund requested: 'full' or 'partial'.

plainFields.name: request_amount
plainFields.description: The total amount requested for refund, if partial refund. Null for full refunds.

plainFields.name: notes
plainFields.description: Additional notes provided about the refund request.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this refund request was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_statuses
models.description: Reference table containing all valid refund status codes. Documents the state machine for refund processing lifecycle. Referenced by shopping_mall_refund_requests. Used to track the current status of any refund request.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Machine-readable code for the status (e.g., "requested", "seller_approved", "admin_denied").

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label for the status (e.g., "Requested", "Seller Approved", "Admin Denied").

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed explanation of what the status means in the business context.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_status_history
models.description: Snapshot table that captures every status change for a refund request. Sequential, append-only history for audit trails. Each record represents a point-in-time state of a refund request. Referenced by shopping_mall_refund_requests.

foreignFields.name: refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: The refund request that this status change belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: status_id
foreignFields.description: The new status code assigned. {@link shopping_mall_refund_statuses.id}.

foreignFields.name: actor_id
foreignFields.description: The admin or customer who triggered this status change. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id} or {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

plainFields.name: previous_status
plainFields.description: The status code before the change, for audit purposes.

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Explanation provided by the actor for the status change.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this status change was recorded.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this history record was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_reasons
models.description: Reference table that contains all valid refund reason codes and descriptions. Used to standardize the reasons for refund requests. Referenced by shopping_mall_refund_requests. Ensures consistent categorization of refund types.

plainFields.name: code
plainFields.description: Machine-readable code for the reason (e.g., "damaged", "wrong_item", "not_delivered").

plainFields.name: label
plainFields.description: Human-readable label for the reason (e.g., "Item Damaged", "Wrong Item Received", "Item Not Delivered").

plainFields.name: is_system
plainFields.description: True if this reason is predefined by the system, false if user-defined.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reason was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reason was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this reason was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_return_labels
models.description: Supporting entity representing a prepaid shipping label for returning refunded items. Created upon approval of a refund request. Each label is associated with exactly one refund request. Managed through the return process, not directly by users.

foreignFields.name: refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: The refund request this label was generated for. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: shipping_carrier_id
foreignFields.description: The carrier used for return shipping. {@link shopping_mall_shipping_carriers.id}.

plainFields.name: tracking_number
plainFields.description: The actual tracking number assigned by the carrier for the return shipment.

plainFields.name: label_url
plainFields.description: URL to download the printable shipping label PDF.

plainFields.name: printed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the customer printed the shipping label, if applicable.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this label was generated.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this label was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this label was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_refund_payments
models.description: Supporting entity that tracks how a refund was processed. Determines if refund went to original payment method or store credit. Each refund request has exactly one payment record. Ensures proper accounting and compliance.

foreignFields.name: refund_request_id
foreignFields.description: The refund request this payment record belongs to. {@link shopping_mall_refund_requests.id}.

foreignFields.name: payment_method_id
foreignFields.description: The payment gateway method used for the refund. {@link shopping_mall_payment_gateways.id}.

plainFields.name: amount
plainFields.description: The total amount refunded in USD.

plainFields.name: currency
plainFields.description: The currency of the refund amount (e.g., 'USD').

plainFields.name: processed_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the refund was successfully processed by the payment gateway.

plainFields.name: refund_method
plainFields.description: How the refund was processed: 'original_payment' or 'store_credit'.

plainFields.name: gateway_transaction_id
plainFields.description: The transaction ID returned by the payment gateway for this refund.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was last updated.

plainFields.name: deleted_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this payment record was logically deleted (soft delete).

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_actions
models.description: High-level administrative actions performed by admins on the platform. This table tracks the essence of each admin action with references to the target entity and the admin who performed it. Each row represents one auditable action, such as suspending a user, overriding an order, or modifying a product. This serves as the primary index for administrative activity. All values are immutable for audit integrity. References to existing entities using @link directives.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who performed this action. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: User affected by this action (customer or seller). Nullable for non-user actions. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} or {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product affected by this action. Nullable for non-product actions. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order affected by this action. Nullable for non-order actions. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_dispute_id
foreignFields.description: Dispute affected by this action. Nullable for non-dispute actions. {@link shopping_mall_admin_disputes.id}.

plainFields.name: action_type
plainFields.description: Type of administrative action taken. Examples: "suspend_user", "override_order", "modify_product", "resolve_dispute". Values should follow [snake_case] naming convention for consistency.

plainFields.name: action_details
plainFields.description: Free-form text describing what was done, especially if more context than the action_type can provide. Example: "Suspended seller due to fraudulent pricing patterns."

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this administrative action was performed. This is immutable and used for audit trail purposes.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_audit_logs
models.description: Detailed audit log tracking every change made by administrators. This table captures specific alterations to objects (including before and after state) and is used for forensic analysis. Unlike admin_actions, this table logs field-level changes, making it essential for compliance and detailed investigations. All records are append-only. References to existing entities using @link directives.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who made this audit change. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_user_id
foreignFields.description: User account affected by this audit change. Nullable for non-user changes. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id} or {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_product_id
foreignFields.description: Product affected by this audit change. Nullable for non-product changes. {@link shopping_mall_products.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order affected by this audit change. Nullable for non-order changes. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: target_type
plainFields.description: Type of target entity being modified (e.g., "user", "product", "order"). This helps direct queries without joining.

plainFields.name: field_name
plainFields.description: Name of the field that was changed (e.g., "status", "price", "email").

plainFields.name: old_value
plainFields.description: The value of the field before the administrative change. Stored as string to handle any data type. Example: "active" or "59.99".

plainFields.name: new_value
plainFields.description: The value of the field after the administrative change. Stored as string to handle any data type. Example: "suspended" or "79.99".

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Reason provided by the admin for making this change. Example: "User was spamming reviews."

plainFields.name: ip_address
plainFields.description: IP address from which the administrative action was performed. Used for security forensics.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this audit trail entry was created. This value is immutable and preserved for historical accuracy.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_disputes
models.description: Stores customer-initiated or system-flagged disputes requiring administrative resolution. A dispute represents an unresolved conflict between a customer and seller regarding an order, product, or service, escalated to admin for review. This table tracks the dispute lifecycle from initiation to resolution. References to existing entities using @link directives.

foreignFields.name: customer_id
foreignFields.description: Customer who initiated the dispute. {@link shopping_mall_customers.id}.

foreignFields.name: seller_id
foreignFields.description: Seller against whom the dispute was filed. {@link shopping_mall_sellers.id}.

foreignFields.name: order_id
foreignFields.description: Order related to this dispute. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

foreignFields.name: dispute_type_id
foreignFields.description: Category or type of dispute. {@link shopping_mall_dispute_types.id}.

plainFields.name: status
plainFields.description: Current status of the dispute. Examples: "open", "in_review", "resolved", "declined".

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Detailed description of the dispute provided by the customer or system. Example: "Received item was damaged and does not match product description."

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the dispute was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the dispute status was last updated.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_dispute_decisions
models.description: Stores final decisions made by administrators on disputes. This table links decisively to admin_disputes and records the outcome, admin reasoning, and any associated actions (like refund or penalty). This ensures a closed-loop audit trail for dispute resolutions. References to existing entities using @link directives.

foreignFields.name: dispute_id
foreignFields.description: The dispute this decision resolves. {@link shopping_mall_admin_disputes.id}.

foreignFields.name: admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who made this decision. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

plainFields.name: decision
plainFields.description: Final decision outcome. Examples: "refund_customer", "penalize_seller", "denied", "both_fault".

plainFields.name: reason
plainFields.description: Detailed reasoning for the administrator's decision. Must be legally compliant and clear. Example: "Customer provided photo evidence of damage; seller refused initial refund. Approved refund of $50.00."

plainFields.name: refund_amount
plainFields.description: Amount of refund issued to customer as part of this decision. Null if no refund was issued.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this decision was recorded in the system.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this decision was last modified.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_access_levels
models.description: Defines and manages levels of administrative authority. This table allows for fine-grained permission control by defining role tiers (e.g., Tier 1, Tier 2) and associating them with specific permissions. This supports scalable admin teams with different access rights. References to existing entities using @link directives.

plainFields.name: level_name
plainFields.description: Human-readable name of the access level. Examples: "Tier 1 - Basic", "Tier 2 - Full", "Tier 3 - Super Admin".

plainFields.name: level_code
plainFields.description: Programmatic code for this access level. Used internally to enforce permissions via conditionals. Examples: "tier1", "tier2", "super".

plainFields.name: permissions
plainFields.description: JSON-formatted string listing all permissions granted at this level, such as ["manage_users", "override_orders", "modify_products", "resolve_disputes"]. Always stored as a JSON array string for consistent serialization.

plainFields.name: description
plainFields.description: Additional description explaining this access level's purpose and scope.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this access level was created.

plainFields.name: updated_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when this access level was last updated.

plainFields.name: is_active
plainFields.description: Whether this access level is currently active and available for assignment. Inactive levels can be retained for audit history.

models.name: shopping_mall_admin_notifications
models.description: Tracks administrative notifications sent to admins or between admins about system events requiring attention. This table acts as a communication channel for urgent matters, such as flagged disputes, low-stock alerts, or permission requests. Messages are marked read/unread and can be queued for delivery. References to existing entities using @link directives.

foreignFields.name: send_to_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who receives this notification. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: sent_by_admin_id
foreignFields.description: Admin who sent this notification. Nullable if system-initiated. {@link shopping_mall_admins.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_dispute_id
foreignFields.description: Dispute related to this notification. Nullable. {@link shopping_mall_admin_disputes.id}.

foreignFields.name: target_order_id
foreignFields.description: Order related to this notification. Nullable. {@link shopping_mall_orders.id}.

plainFields.name: title
plainFields.description: Brief subject line or title of the notification. Example: "Urgent: High-value dispute requires review."

plainFields.name: message
plainFields.description: Full body of the notification message, providing context and action required. Example: "Customer has escalated dispute #12345 regarding order #67890. Please review within 24 hours."

plainFields.name: type
plainFields.description: Category of notification. Examples: "dispute_alert", "system_alert", "request_approve", "policy_update".

plainFields.name: is_read
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if the recipient has viewed the notification.

plainFields.name: is_urgent
plainFields.description: Flag indicating if this notification requires immediate attention from the recipient.

plainFields.name: created_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the notification was generated and queued for delivery.

plainFields.name: read_at
plainFields.description: Timestamp when the recipient marked the notification as read. Null if unread.
